defaultDesc:
Reuses one argument array for script callbacks instead of allocating one per hit.
Stops the GC stutter on dense charts. Off = stock per-hit allocation.
Online disables it automatically.

OFF (default): fired chart events stay in eventNotes and a cursor walks past them;
draining a whole song costs O(N) instead of O(N^2).
ON = stock Array.shift(): every fired event leaves the array, so a script that reads
or edits eventNotes sees exactly the old contents.

OFF (default): Conductor.getBPMFromSeconds() returns one reused object when no BPM
change is in effect (no per-call allocation).
ON = stock behaviour: a fresh object every call, so an HScript that holds two results
keeps them independent. The binary search itself stays on in both modes.

OFF (default): the side HUD labels and the time text are only rewritten when their
value or second changed (saves 9 strings per frame; the visible result is identical).
ON = stock behaviour: rewrite every frame, so text a script writes there is overwritten
again on the very next frame.
